newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar firmer but off highs by late Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar firmer but off highs by late Tokyo.

text.p: The dollar strengthened against the yen and mark by late afternoon Tokyo on Monday but was off earlier highs after a lack of follow-through purchases kept a lid on its rises, dealers said.
A bullish mood on the dollar grew after the Group of Seven (G7) meeting on Sunday failed to specifically mention the yen's recent weakness against the dollar as a shared concern.

The dollar hit 1.7395 marks, its highest level since February 1994, after Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said at the G7 meeting that foreign exchange rates reflected economic fundamentals, but retreated following Tietmeyer's later remarks that the United States was interested in a strong dollar, but not in a stronger dollar, dealers said.
A dealer at a European bank in Singapore said the dollar had been well bid around 1.7295 marks.
